sloka: एतच् च वचनम् श्रुत्वा सुग्रीवस्य सुभाषितम् ।प्रत्ययार्थम् महातेजा रामो जग्राह कार्मुकम् ॥४-१२-१॥
transliteration: etac ca vacanam śrutvā sugrīvasya subhāṣitam ।pratyayārtham mahātejā rāmo jagrāha kārmukam ॥4-12-1॥

translations.english: Having heard Sugriva's pleasing words, the brilliant Rama took up the bow in order to inspire confidence in Sugriva.
